about: The grid. Every module and every stored path has a slot here. scripts/architecture.mjs checks the code against it on every npm test. Read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before changing this file.

core.means: Rules with no outside world: no page, no network, no storage, no Firebase. Pure and fully testable.

adapters.means: The only code that talks to the outside world. Each one is a plug point that can be swapped.

shell.means: The app frame and shared pieces of interface: routing, layout, toasts, the bell, the calculator.

router.means: The router: reads the address and loads the right screen. The only file that may load every layer.

views.means: One file per screen. Thin: they arrange the page and call the layers below.

data.now: Cloud Firestore (cloud.js), browser storage for offline (store.js)
later: A university's own database or storage, chosen per institution

ai.now: The professor's or student's own AI through the Cramming connector (connector/)
later: A university's approved AI, billed per use

lms.now: Canvas roster import (roster.js) and grade export (canvas.js)
later: LTI 1.3: roster sync, grade passback, deep links

files.now: None stored; text is read in the browser (materials.js)
later: File and photo uploads in institution storage

data.about: Every stored path. 'since' is the schema version a new path starts at; paths from before versioning are 0. New paths start at 1 and every document they hold carries v.

users.holds: A person's profile and synced progress

signins.holds: Who has signed in, by email

enrollments.holds: Which classes an email belongs to

classes.holds: A class: one course offering with its sections, staff and settings

buildLinks.holds: Secret link from a professor's AI to the class it builds

tutorLinks.holds: Secret link from a student's AI to the class tutor

accessRequests.holds: Request access from the public pages: who (step 1), optional course details (step 2), and the status and note admins set. Never deleted.

accessLimits.holds: Daily counters the connector keeps for Request access: per network and per email (keyed hashes only) and for the whole site. Nobody reads them from the site.

assignmentFiles.holds: Programming assignment sources and hidden tests (staff)

materialText.holds: Text read from course materials, in chunks (staff)

builder.holds: Build my course: setup and progress

built.holds: Build my course: each finished step

announcements.holds: Messages from staff to the class

tests.holds: Graded work shown to students (no answers)

testKeys.holds: Answer keys and hidden tests (staff only)

testExtra.holds: Extra time and new attempts per student

attempts.holds: A student's attempt at graded work

attemptArchive.holds: Earlier attempts kept when a new one is given

summaries.holds: A student's practice summary per set

code.holds: A student's saved code per assignment

signins.holds: Students of this class who have signed in

budgets.about: Lines per file. A file may shrink but never grow past its budget; a new file gets the default. Split a file before it reaches its budget.

debt.about: Known breaks of the grid, allowed only until fixed. The checks fail if any NEW break appears, and remind us of these.

imports.why: Spaced review reads saved progress directly. Pass the progress in instead.
imports.fix: When practice is polished (rename engine.js to review.js at the same time).

firebaseErrorCodesInViews.fix: cloud.js turns errors into plain reasons (denied, offline, missing) so screens never see Firebase codes.

design.about: The look is set once, in the tokens file, and every stylesheet uses it. New stylesheets may not write colours of their own; old ones may only lose them. Rules for using the tokens: docs/DESIGN.md.

app/css/app.css.fix: Move the signed-in app onto the tokens when the design kit is built (Inter, the Clear palette).
